Enc.description:
How a message was encrypted.

Designed but not implemented; see `docs/specs/message.md`. Readers already
recognize the shape so that an encrypted message is displayed as a placeholder
rather than as unreadable JSON.

alg.description: The AEAD algorithm. An open enum; `A256GCM` is the first one.

kid.description: The identifier of the pre-shared key that encrypted this message.

Level.description: Message severity, normalized to lowercase. An open enum: a value outside the examples is preserved in lowercase and displayed as `info`.

Payload.description: The readable content of a message.

body.description: The main text. May be empty when `data` carries the content.

contentType.description: A hint for `body`, such as `text/markdown`. Defaults to `text/plain`.

title.description: Used as the notification title when present.

app.description: The producing application, `hmc` or `hmg` for the HiveMe tools.

appVersion.description: The version of the producing application.

id.description: The `device.id` of the installation that produced the message.

description: A HiveMe message envelope. Generated from hiveme-core; see docs/specs/message.md.

oneOf.description: Carries a ciphertext and the header needed to decrypt it.
oneOf.title: Encrypted

ciphertext.description: The base64url AEAD output. Present exactly when `enc` is.

enc.description: The encryption header. Absent on a plaintext message.

id.description: A unique identifier, UUID v7 for messages HiveMe writes.

payload.description: The readable content. Absent on an encrypted message.

replyTo.description: The `id` of another message. Reserved for threading.

ts.description: RFC 3339 with a timezone and millisecond precision, from the producer's clock.

ttlSecs.description: Mirrors the MQTT message expiry so a reader can show staleness.

type.description: An open enum; `message` unless stated otherwise.

title: HiveMe message
